subject.title: Main-target cron scripts cannot be cancelled and can notify after restart

question: Should the broader repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111292 be the canonical fix for this issue, rather than landing only the cancellation-focused subset in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111291?
rationale: The linked proposals overlap, but the broader candidate claims to cover scheduler-generation ownership and cross-path script handling that the narrower candidate does not clearly establish; choosing the intended repair scope requires maintainer judgment.

options.title: Use the broader canonical repair
options.body: Review and land the broader candidate if its shared detached-execution classification and generation checks are validated across the affected cron paths.

options.title: Land the narrow fix first
options.body: Land the cancellation-focused candidate only if maintainers confirm generation ownership and stale-result suppression are independently covered or intentionally deferred.

options.title: Request consolidation
options.body: Ask the contributors to converge on one focused canonical patch and shared regression suite before merge.

recommendation.title: Use the broader canonical repair
recommendation.body: Review and land the broader candidate if its shared detached-execution classification and generation checks are validated across the affected cron paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and the broader cross-path repair candidate both trace to this contributor.
